title: Clay Studio Membership with Raku Kiln Access
source_quote: Membership includes a $25 discount on clay classes and workshops, access to the studio, tools, and glazes, use of pottery wheels, and kiln firings. The Art of Clay Studio is equipped with two electric kilns, a raku kiln, eight wheels, a slab roller, an extruder, and a selection of colored slips, Amaco Underglazes, and a wide selection of cone six glazes.
evidence_sentence: Clay Studio members have access to kiln firings including a raku kiln.
evidence_quote: Membership includes a $25 discount on clay classes and workshops, access to the studio, tools, and glazes, use of pottery wheels, and kiln firings.
how_to_join: Contact Jeffrey Lipton, Clay Studio Coordinator, or join a waitlist
summary: Intermediate-level studio members (with 2+ years experience) can access the raku kiln and electric kilns at the Art of Clay Studio in Waterville.
